analytical_dimensions.description: How the thinker is cited here
probing_questions: What does the author do with the thinker at this passage: authority, evidence, foil, dialogue, genealogy, illustration, courtesy, or self-positioning; and does the author adopt, build on, qualify, dispute or merely mention the cited position?

analytical_dimensions.description: Why the passage needs the citation
probing_questions: Which claim, evidence or distinction does the passage advance with the thinker, and what qualification limits that reading?

analytical_dimensions.description: How the passage and the citation fit the text's argument
probing_questions: Where in the text's argument does this section sit, and what does the citation do for that argument?
Across the supplied texts, does the thinker's role persist or change, and which paired passages establish that?

engine_name: One citation explained in its place
problematique: One citation of a thinker P in a text by A, read in the section where it sits. Say how P is cited here (the move made with the citation and the stance toward what is cited), why the passage needs the citation (the local claim it carries and the qualification that limits it), and how the passage and the citation fit the text's argument (where the section sits in that argument and what the citation does for it). Quote the sentence that carries the citation verbatim; the code checks that it is in the section. Confine the reading to the section, the profile and the author's other citations of P supplied; never say what P wrote beyond what the text itself says of it. Given several texts, say what shifts between them.
researcher_question: How and why does this author cite this thinker here, and what does the citation do for the text's argument?
